RED RAINFALL WARNING RAISED IN ZAMBALES AS MONSOON RAINS INTENSIFY

PAGASA raised a Red Rainfall Warning over Zambales at 11 a.m. Wednesday due to intense rains from the enhanced southwest monsoon. The red alert signals serious flooding in flood-prone areas.

An Orange Warning is in effect over Bataan, Pampanga, Metro Manila, Cavite, Tarlac and several areas in Bulacan, including Malolos, Meycauayan, Marilao and Calumpit, where flooding remains threatening.

Meanwhile, Yellow Warning is up in Batangas, Rizal, Laguna and other parts of Tarlac and Bulacan, where flooding in low-lying areas is still possible.
